facts: The algorithm is for learning the time-varying shape of a non-rigid 3D object.
The algorithm uses uncalibrated 2D tracking data.
The model of shape motion includes a rigid component.
The rigid component includes rotation and translation.
The model of shape motion combines a rigid component with a non-rigid deformation.
Reconstruction is ill-posed if arbitrary deformations are allowed.
The problem is constrained by assuming that the object shape at each time instant is drawn from a Gaussian distribution.
The object shape at each time instant is drawn from a Gaussian distribution.
The algorithm simultaneously estimates 3D shape and motion for each time frame.
The algorithm learns the parameters of the Gaussian.
The algorithm robustly fills-in missing data points.
The algorithm is extended to model temporal smoothness in object shape.
Modeling temporal smoothness in object shape allows the algorithm to handle severe cases of missing data.
entities: learning the time-varying shape of a non-rigid 3D object
